_jobApplication.jobTitle: AI Engineering Lead - Portfolio AI Enablement
_jobApplication.jobDescription: AI Engineering Lead – Portfolio AI Enablement. Europe (Remote), regular travel across Europe required. Volaris Group is looking for an experienced AI Engineering Lead to help accelerate AI adoption across a portfolio of 40+ European software businesses. Hands-on role focused on enabling software engineering organisations to embed AI across the full software development lifecycle. Work directly with R&D leaders and engineering teams to improve development practices, accelerate AI adoption, and help portfolio companies move toward AI-native engineering operations. Not focused on building centralised AI products or platforms; focus is on enablement, transformation, governance, and helping individual businesses adopt best-in-class AI engineering practices. Operate across multiple software businesses, immerse in new technical environments quickly, help leadership teams identify practical, high-impact AI opportunities. Responsibilities: partner with R&D leaders to drive AI adoption; enable engineering orgs to integrate AI across SDLC; guide teams on AI coding workflows, agents, code review, testing automation, engineering productivity; advise on AI governance, guardrails, security, implementation best practices; assess technical maturity; support accelerator-style transformation; challenge technical assumptions and shape AI roadmaps; help newly acquired companies accelerate AI maturity; share best practices across the portfolio; contribute hands-on. Looking for: strong software engineering background with deep exposure to AI-enabled development practices; experience implementing AI tools across SDLC; strong understanding of modern AI engineering workflows and LLM-enabled development; ability to influence senior engineering stakeholders and R&D leaders; comfortable across multiple technical environments; strong consulting and enablement skills; curious and adaptable; comfortable travelling across Europe. Ideal background: Senior AI Engineer, AI Engineering Lead, Staff/Principal Engineer with strong AI adoption experience, AI Transformation Engineer, Engineering Enablement Lead. Nice to have: experience across multiple business units or portfolio environments; exposure to PE-backed software orgs; engineering transformation initiatives; AI governance and operational guardrails; product-oriented mindset with commercial awareness.
_jobApplication.notes: Tailored for portfolio-style enablement role. Led with Tenity (closest analog), LumApps governance/transformation work, and Beekeeper LLM-in-SDLC pipeline.
